# TASK-154 — specification

## Scope

Non-repeating conversation: selecting the active question is idempotent; navigation does not repeat canned introductions or masquerade as a skipped answer; explicit question editing remains available. Cover repeated selection and next-question progression.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Repeated outline selections must not append the same question.
- [ ] Navigation is not a skipped answer; reopening a saved answer is explicit.
- [ ] Preserve answer history, review and deterministic next-question logic.
